items.statement: The submitted calculation identifies the public 22-atom structure as neutral and singlet and reports a reproducible electronic-structure setup at zero field.
items.expected: Charge 0, multiplicity 1, zero field, 22 atoms, method/software and convergence provenance are all explicitly reported.

items.statement: The calculation includes an outcome-based stationarity or geometry validation and an independent convergence/check calculation.
items.expected: The report provides concrete evidence of optimization/frequency or a justified fixed-geometry alternative, plus an independent convergence/check result.

items.statement: The zero-field isolated A-D molecule has a dipole magnitude close to the source-reported value.
items.expected: Dipole magnitude is approximately 2.67 Debye, with sign/axis convention stated.
